5
Abrabɔ bɔne a ada adi wɔ asafo no mu
1 # Lew 18.7-8 Wɔabɛka sɛ adwamammɔ wɔ mo mu, adwamammɔ a ɛnni abosonsomfoɔ mpo mu, sɛ obi ne n’agya yere da. 2Na morehoahoa mo ho, na mo werɛ anho amma wɔanyi deɛ ɔyɛɛ saa adeɛ no amfiri mo mu. 3#Kol 2.5 Na me deɛ, menni hɔ honam fam deɛ, nanso mewɔ hɔ honhom mu, na mabu deɛ ɔyɛɛ saa adeɛ yi atɛn dada te sɛ deɛ mewɔ hɔ. 4#Mat 16.19; 18.18; 2 Ko 13.10 Sɛ mo ne me honhom hyia yɛn Awurade Yesu din mu na yɛn Awurade Yesu tumi ka ho a, 5#1 Ti 1.20 momfa onii no nhyɛ Satan nsa, na honam no nsɛe, na ebia wɔagye honhom no nkwa, Awurade da no.
6 # Gal 5.9 Mo ahohoahoa no nyɛ fɛ. Monnim sɛ mmɔreka kakra na ɛka mmɔre no nyinaa? 7#Eks 13.7; Yes 53.7; 1 Pe 1.19 Enti monyi mmɔreka dada no, na moayɛ mmɔre foforɔ sɛdeɛ moyɛ apiti no. Ɛfiri sɛ wɔakum yɛn Twam dwan Kristo no nso. 8#Eks 12.3-20 Enti momma yɛnhyɛ fa; ɛnyɛ mmɔreka dada no mu, nanso ɛnyɛ bɔneyɛ ne amumuyɛ mmɔreka mu, na mmom Kronkronyɛ ne nokorɛ apiti mu.
Wɔammu Paulo kɔkɔbɔ
9 # Mat 18.17; 2 Te 3.14 Metwerɛɛ wɔ me krataa no mu sɛ mo ne adwamammɔfoɔ nnni afra. 10Ɛnyɛ wiase adwamammɔfoɔ anaa aniberefoɔ ne amimfoɔ anaa abosonsomfoɔ ho asɛm koraa na mereka; ɛnneɛ na anka ɛsɛ sɛ mofiri wiase fire. 11#2 Te 3.6; Tito 3.10; 2 Yoh 10 Na afei matwerɛ mo sɛ, sɛ obi a wɔfrɛ no onua yɛ odwamamfoɔ anaa oniberefoɔ anaa ɔbosonsonni anaa tɔkwapɛfoɔ anaa sabofoɔ anaa omimfoɔ a, mo ne no mmmɔ; saa onipa no, mo ne no nnnidi mpo. 12#Mar 4.11 Na ɛfa me ho bɛn na merebu wɔn a wɔmfra mo mu no nso atɛn bie? Ɛnyɛ wɔn a wɔfra mo mu no na mobu wɔn atɛn? 13#Deut 13.5 Na wɔn a wɔmfra mo mu no, Onyankopɔn bɛbu wɔn atɛn. Monyi deɛ ɔyɛ ɔbɔnefoɔ no mfiri mo mu.

pageProps.chapterText:
Wɔabɛka sɛ adwamammɔ wɔ mo mu, adwamammɔ a ɛnni abosonsomfoɔ mpo mu, sɛ obi ne n’agya yere da. Na morehoahoa mo ho, na mo werɛ anho amma wɔanyi deɛ ɔyɛɛ saa adeɛ no amfiri mo mu. Na me deɛ, menni hɔ honam fam deɛ, nanso mewɔ hɔ honhom mu, na mabu deɛ ɔyɛɛ saa adeɛ yi atɛn dada te sɛ deɛ mewɔ hɔ. Sɛ mo ne me honhom hyia yɛn Awurade Yesu din mu na yɛn Awurade Yesu tumi ka ho a, momfa onii no nhyɛ Satan nsa, na honam no nsɛe, na ebia wɔagye honhom no nkwa, Awurade da no.
Mo ahohoahoa no nyɛ fɛ. Monnim sɛ mmɔreka kakra na ɛka mmɔre no nyinaa? Enti monyi mmɔreka dada no, na moayɛ mmɔre foforɔ sɛdeɛ moyɛ apiti no. Ɛfiri sɛ wɔakum yɛn Twam dwan Kristo no nso. Enti momma yɛnhyɛ fa; ɛnyɛ mmɔreka dada no mu, nanso ɛnyɛ bɔneyɛ ne amumuyɛ mmɔreka mu, na mmom Kronkronyɛ ne nokorɛ apiti mu.

Metwerɛɛ wɔ me krataa no mu sɛ mo ne adwamammɔfoɔ nnni afra. Ɛnyɛ wiase adwamammɔfoɔ anaa aniberefoɔ ne amimfoɔ anaa abosonsomfoɔ ho asɛm koraa na mereka; ɛnneɛ na anka ɛsɛ sɛ mofiri wiase fire. Na afei matwerɛ mo sɛ, sɛ obi a wɔfrɛ no onua yɛ odwamamfoɔ anaa oniberefoɔ anaa ɔbosonsonni anaa tɔkwapɛfoɔ anaa sabofoɔ anaa omimfoɔ a, mo ne no mmmɔ; saa onipa no, mo ne no nnnidi mpo. Na ɛfa me ho bɛn na merebu wɔn a wɔmfra mo mu no nso atɛn bie? Ɛnyɛ wɔn a wɔfra mo mu no na mobu wɔn atɛn? Na wɔn a wɔmfra mo mu no, Onyankopɔn bɛbu wɔn atɛn. Monyi deɛ ɔyɛ ɔbɔnefoɔ no mfiri mo mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
